_doc: Proposed hardpoints (robot frame mm, Z from floor at ext=70). Printed PETG brackets on M5 T-nuts, each carrying M3 heat-set inserts. Panels hold no inserts. face = frame face the bracket sits on.

hardpoints.where: upper box top front rail, front face
upper box top rear rail, rear face, at Y +-85 (moved from +-60 on 2026-11-06: the boss sat on the D1 door edge |Y|<=60); also anchors the upper spine-pad standoffs
hardpoints.carries: U2 upper back (top edge), D3 hatch catch

hardpoints.where: step shared rail, front and rear faces, between the gusset plates
hardpoints.carries: U1/U2 bottom edge, U3/U4 top edge, D1 door frame

hardpoints.where: lower box bottom rails, front and rear faces
hardpoints.carries: U3/U4 bottom edge, D2 door frame

hardpoints.where: lower box corner posts, outer side faces
hardpoints.carries: U3/U4 side edge, V1 vent grille

hardpoints.where: lower box bottom side rails, outer side faces (moved off the under-face, which stays free for the waist adapter / hip interface; torso-frame thread 2026-11-06)
pitch RS03 outer ring, 8 unused outboard M4 holes per side
hardpoints.carries: collar halves; U1/U2 socket rims lap onto them (location only)
